issues.desc: background.md and index.json description both cite cli-engine.ts:4003 as the phase write and :4010 as the dev_start call, and :4022-4024 as the no-rollback path. Reading the actual source: line 4003 is an `if (!gitReady)` guard; the story_advance call (phase write) is at line 4040 and dev_start is at line 4047; the catch block with no rollback is at lines 4059-4061, not 4022-4024. The underlying behavior claim (non-atomic sequence, no rollback) is correct, but the three cited line numbers are inaccurate and will mislead the implementer trying to locate the code.

CHK-002 userSees mentions a documented recovery command that recreates the worktree and prints its path, but does not specify (a) the command name/syntax the user would type, or (b) where the documentation would surface (--help, error message hint, CLAUDE.md). During PLAN, ensure the recovery command is named and that the error path from CHK-001 includes a hint pointing the user to the recovery command, so the user does not have to guess what to run next.
